Film Notes: Pierrot le Fou (1965)

November 10, 2026

Pierrot le Fou (1965) film notes by John Trafton for the Nouvelles Femmes series, presented by Alliance Française, SIFF, and Greg Olson Productions. Series curated and written by Greg Olson. Inspired by the work of Ericka Knudson, author of "Nouvelles Femmes: Modern Women of the French New Wave and Their Enduring Contribution to Cinema" The series runs through November 2026 at SIFF Cinema Uptown.
